text:
ana_partnerships: quick thread to finalize the SI handoff protocol for the upcoming marketplace + hw co-launch. primary goals: 1) prevent stalled leads, 2) consistent account mapping, 3) simple escalation path. comments?

sam_sales: Quick ask 3) define "SI-introduced" vs "marketplace" leads. Also want a short SLA for claims.

mike_se: Proposal: hot leads = 48h claim window, warm = 72h. SI-introduced = partner sends intro email or fastpass token. marketplace inbound = no token. Tag leads with partner_origin, si_name, listing_id.

rachel_ps: Marketing will need a 1-pager and a short outreach template for SI reps. Also request an "SI-enabled" badge asset for the listing.

jordan_ops: Ops: we'll add fields partner_score and fastpass_token to lead schema, plus an "SI claimed" status. We'll alert #partner-triage if claim window expires.

courtney_partnerrep: From partner side: fastpass tokens are fine but need validation. we want 72h to prep before claim becomes public.

ana_partnerships: decision notes: fastpass validity = 72h; claim windows as mike suggested. For co-billing requires LOA for deals > $50k. Legal to review PR copy.

sam_sales: Routing pseudo logic request: can someone drop a compact if/else table?

mike_se: dropping simple logic snippet: 

if (fastpass_valid) -> route=si-immediate, claim=72h;
else if (partner_score>=70 && tier==enterprise) -> route=si-priority, claim=48h;
else if (hw_tag && tier!=small) -> route=hw-si-first, claim=48h;
else -> route=hosted-first, claim=72h.

jordan_ops: I'll prototype webhook payload and add fulfillment flag for hw demos.

rachel_ps: I'll send enablement + templates by Fri and schedule a 30-min run-through with SI reps next Wed.

ana_partnerships: next steps assigned: sam compile partner overrides; mike finalize routing table; rachel draft enablement; jordan ops implement fields + webhook prototype. syncing Mon 11am PT. thanks all :thumbsup:
